Font Awesome Free 6.7.2
https://fontawesome.com
Vendored (self-hosted) rather than loaded from a CDN: the published preview
runs under a CSP that blocks every external host, so a CDN link would fail
silently there. Only the .woff2 faces are shipped; the .ttf fallbacks were
stripped from the src lists in all.min.css. Nothing else was modified.
